pernicious.example: Smoking has a pernicious effect on nearly every organ in the body.
pernicious.example_zh: 吸菸對身體幾乎每個器官都有有害的影響。

subordinate.example: A good leader treats subordinate staff with the same respect as senior colleagues.
subordinate.example_zh: 好的領導者對下屬與資深同事一視同仁地尊重。

vulnerable.example: Newborns are especially vulnerable to infection because their immune systems are immature.
vulnerable.example_zh: 新生兒因免疫系統尚未成熟，特別容易受到感染。

affluent.example: She grew up in an affluent neighborhood where every house had a pool.
affluent.example_zh: 她在一個富裕的社區長大，家家戶戶都有泳池。

alleviated.example: The new medication alleviated her chronic back pain within days.
alleviated.example_zh: 新藥在幾天內就減輕了她的慢性背痛。

amassed.example: Over decades he amassed a vast collection of rare medical texts.
amassed.example_zh: 數十年間他累積了大量珍稀的醫學典籍。

apathy.example: Voter apathy led to the lowest turnout in the country's history.
apathy.example_zh: 選民的冷漠造成該國史上最低的投票率。

auspicious.example: The clear sky was an auspicious start to their wedding day.
auspicious.example_zh: 晴朗的天空為他們的婚禮揭開了吉祥的序幕。

blur.example: Tears blurred her vision as she read the letter.
blur.example_zh: 讀信時，淚水模糊了她的視線。

commodious.example: The hotel suite was commodious enough for the whole family.
commodious.example_zh: 這間飯店套房寬敞到足以容納全家人。

conscientious.example: A conscientious student reviews her notes the same day she takes them.
conscientious.example_zh: 盡責的學生當天就會複習當天的筆記。

considerate.example: It was considerate of you to call before visiting.
considerate.example_zh: 你來訪前先打電話，真是體貼。

contagious.example: Measles is highly contagious and spreads through the air.
contagious.example_zh: 麻疹傳染性極強，會透過空氣傳播。

contentious.example: Funding for the project remains a contentious issue in the committee.
contentious.example_zh: 該計畫的經費在委員會中仍是個有爭議的議題。

deficiency.example: A deficiency of vitamin D can lead to weakened bones.
deficiency.example_zh: 維生素 D 缺乏可能導致骨骼變弱。

empirical.example: Their conclusion is backed by empirical evidence from years of experiments.
empirical.example_zh: 他們的結論有多年實驗的實證證據支持。

entitled.example: Full-time employees are entitled to paid annual leave.
entitled.example_zh: 全職員工有資格享有帶薪年假。

external.example: The wound healed, but an external scar remained.
external.example_zh: 傷口癒合了，但外部留下了疤痕。

gullible.example: He was gullible enough to believe the email promising him a fortune.
gullible.example_zh: 他輕信到相信那封承諾給他財富的電子郵件。

immune.example: Once you have had the disease, you may be immune to it for life.
immune.example_zh: 一旦得過這種病，你可能終生對它免疫。

impecunious.example: As an impecunious student, he survived on instant noodles.
impecunious.example_zh: 身為一個身無分文的學生，他靠泡麵度日。

indifferent.example: She remained indifferent to the criticism and continued her work.
indifferent.example_zh: 她對批評漠不關心，繼續做她的工作。

indispensable.example: Clean water is indispensable to public health.
indispensable.example_zh: 乾淨的水對公共衛生不可或缺。

inflated.example: The report gave an inflated estimate of the project's benefits.
inflated.example_zh: 該報告對計畫效益給出了誇大的估計。

internal.example: The company launched an internal investigation into the leak.
internal.example_zh: 公司針對洩密展開了內部調查。

intoxicated.example: He was intoxicated and could not drive home safely.
intoxicated.example_zh: 他喝醉了，無法安全開車回家。

jeopardize.example: One careless mistake could jeopardize the entire mission.
jeopardize.example_zh: 一個粗心的錯誤可能危及整個任務。

judicious.example: A judicious use of resources kept the clinic running through the crisis.
judicious.example_zh: 明智地運用資源，讓診所撐過了危機。

lucrative.example: Cosmetic surgery can be a highly lucrative specialty.
lucrative.example_zh: 整形外科可以是利潤很高的專科。

mandatory.example: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory for all passengers.
mandatory.example_zh: 所有乘客都必須強制繫安全帶。

meticulous.example: The surgeon is meticulous about sterilizing every instrument.
meticulous.example_zh: 這位外科醫師對每件器械的消毒都一絲不苟。

optimistic.example: Doctors are optimistic that she will make a full recovery.
optimistic.example_zh: 醫生樂觀地認為她會完全康復。

ostentatious.example: He drove an ostentatious sports car to impress his clients.
ostentatious.example_zh: 他開著一輛炫耀的跑車來打動客戶。

perpetrate.example: The hackers perpetrated the fraud from another country.
perpetrate.example_zh: 駭客從另一個國家犯下這起詐騙。

primitive.example: Primitive tools made of stone have been found at the site.
primitive.example_zh: 遺址出土了以石頭製成的原始工具。

progressive.example: The disease causes a progressive loss of memory.
progressive.example_zh: 這種疾病會造成漸進性的記憶喪失。

release.example: The gland releases hormones directly into the bloodstream.
release.example_zh: 腺體將荷爾蒙直接釋放進血液中。

restrain.example: She could barely restrain her anger during the meeting.
restrain.example_zh: 會議中她幾乎無法抑制自己的怒氣。

revoked.example: His medical license was revoked after the scandal.
revoked.example_zh: 醜聞之後，他的醫師執照被撤銷。

spirit.example: The team showed great fighting spirit despite the setback.
spirit.example_zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，團隊仍展現了高昂的奮鬥精神。

tentative.example: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.

tertiary.example: Tertiary education includes universities and colleges.
tertiary.example_zh: 高等教育包含大學與學院。

ubiquitous.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
ubiquitous.example_zh: 智慧型手機在現代生活中已無所不在。

uniform.example: The samples were kept at a uniform temperature throughout the test.
uniform.example_zh: 整個實驗過程中，樣本都維持在一致的溫度。

virulent.example: A virulent strain of the virus spread rapidly through the ward.
virulent.example_zh: 一種劇毒的病毒株在病房中迅速傳播。
